value.rationale: Gradient--momentum sign agreement is the defining mechanism of PowerSign and AddSign. The result shows that this binary signal has a non-obvious blind window: even the highest-frequency sign alternation is classified as full agreement whenever the alternating amplitudes are moderately balanced. Outside the window the gate systematically amplifies the larger-amplitude parity and suppresses the smaller one. The thresholds are exact, parameter-transparent, and directly interpretable at the source default.
